input: Any commit that modifies /moves/knight_b8.text must be signed by knight_b8 and co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys, and any commit that modifies /moves/<agent>.text must also modify /turn/ply.num so that a move is only accepted together with its ply.
